gaps: Media Card: Description is used only by Size=Large (Default shows Track Metadata) - by design
States use whole-variant opacity (file convention) instead of M3 state-layer frames; state-layer tokens were not approved
Search Bar has no Focused / Hovered state (tapping it opens the Search screen)
Tooltip Rich has no title or actions yet
Library Shortcut Tile variants share the default label and icon (Likes, favorite); instances set them
12 icon instances without a swap property (Status Bar 3, Checkbox 6, Playlist App Bar 1, List Header 2): fixed system or control glyphs
Navigation Item has no M3 active-indicator pill; the source app marks the selected item with color only

Sizes follow the source app over Material 3 (Abdul, 2026-10-13): Search Bar 42, Bottom Navigation 58 (items 52), Mini Player 56, Shortcut Card 56, Podcast Episode Card 186 with an outline_variant border; hit areas stay 48 dp through the item width and row height
Playback Progress: no thumb and inset bar (source: full-bleed 4 dp with a round thumb)
Lyrics: no top/bottom fade on the lyric lines
Explore / Library: header offsets of 5-20 px vs the source screenshots
